verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a project-management tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no documented bulk-edit or bulk-update capability. The API docs mention only single-item endpoints (Create Category, Delete Category) and a general automation claim, which are developer building blocks. The 'move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration' automation and the Jira/CSV import are adjacent features, not user-driven bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
